answer:
The ability to keep HNSW indexes intact across a major PostgreSQL upgrade with `pg_upgrade` was introduced in **pgvector 0.6.0**.  
The changelog for that release includes the upgrade‑related notes that describe this new capability:

> "If upgrading with Postgres 12 or Docker, see [these notes](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector#060)."  
>  [pgvector/CHANGELOG.md (lines 102‑116)]
